pages.text: --- Page 1 --- DATE NIAWLAHO --- Page 2 --- "BOOH NAM" HAKAHI DHAR --- Page 3 --- DATE --- Page 7 --- Niaw-Laho 'IEI HOK MANTRE DA KUNE" Du U WANSALAN E DHAR --- Page 9 --- Da Booh Nam la kan ha kot hei pyrtuid hei nam iongka Diahmal kawa maiaka iong!
Ka Tynrawde KA HAKAHIDHAR I sniaw iong I ia pha ym wiar I nei pyrkhat, Ym kyllep de ha'u nood wei mynsien iong , Dur wamiat kynthai iong pha diahmai wa mala.
Y'm plaeh de 1 nei chynna waba k khmat iong 1.
Han wan pho laem nae hi-eh leh kamwa unke, Heh cha pyrthai katwa, I won kam ka iung ka sem.
I mynsien siaw lakam wa khloh wow nood, Wada lai pho cheiw tawan i thaw rwa toh u chongneh pho, Hawa kynmo kynmo ia pha diahmai shiaw da kthang.
Wow nood wci mynsien khymbloob ki thwa!
umkhmat la kini ki umkhmat wahap na ki khmat, wakal, Ha ki ngab iong nga, pyllang o ki man ki por.

Hawa kynmo O ia pha kat hadooh wow langki kam kathwal, Wow ioh O u pyngkat ei nam I iong pha diah wa maia Han du chilaem, ka'u seini thyllej, Lakam ka I'er wa khlem ioh rap, Dang hawa khyr-ih, wamut o'u khmied, Pha dalai,da dep wow palat Chongsuk Diahmai ha dwar u Blar, ksan nia neitu,ia 1cha pyrthal --- Page 10 --- Ki Kyntien iahkhmat Daslem ki por ki snem wa kbai wa kyrha, ki paid waboon da em sakhat ki hel 1ooluti,dang heini wupou lut.

Nangkong e-ngooh o ia U Trekirot neibynta 1kyrkhu khyrdoh 110ng O wa da 1oh 1u ksoh ia kanka kothakt.Kam u waheh nongiah lutt uwa em itae 1 thrang 1 angnood ieiwow mth ki khynrookikhylloodkiwow chum iakanka bynta ha kawowboohthupiei stad iongrim,sniawokamwa -dapor ha wamang!.

Dhar kam u khynroo uwa da sniaw iei kbai iei kyrha da chim u ia u Daba da lipsiahu cha rakut,da thap duma-da ch'beh din u iauDaba daki r'nguw wa r'hi na itpai- din wa man ka chlem itip istad u Niawwasa...Da pyllang u ia ki r'ngaw wa r'ht chithaw don ioh 1 u iuchit iasyaid - ki r'ngau wa r'hi kiua man ki kyntien "Niaw Laho" hiwa dasdang u pleh heijooh ipor kiwa lada ymslu deiwi tuwan heint wot ipor iymslem u kylla putheh ki ien kynnoo iong i.
I rhi iwa man"ka sabad"heiwow chna ia ki jaid r'wai Niaw Laho ileh u dooh u dam i.
Deiwa pynmih ia kan ka kotkawa em kamwa 52 tylli ki kyntien "Niaw Laho", ngeit o wow nang pynpoor ko ia u kse ha ki patein kawa toh u p'teini ia kan ka sabad.

Dhar da chim u ia ka iukit wow kit deiwa pyllang tae tawar du kat khon waie u ioh ia k kyntien kiwa dadep thlieh chwa kiwaheh wasian nachwa kipor dang emkam sakiiukton ioh u le u pynheh ia i kynton ia kini ki jait rwai.Kamtae dawa 1ia ph kam ki nougpurae kiwaemi tip ia kint
